edges.reason: Owned constructor derives the privileged owner directly from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before setting newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to complete ownership transfer.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using caller-controlled address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller.
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller as spender.
Constructor writes the owner state variable that gates all privileged paths.
Owner-gated transferOwnership stages the privileged newOwner variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the privileged owner variable.
acceptOwnership clears the pending newOwner after handover.
Constructor assigns the computed supply to _totalSupply.
Constructor performs an unchecked multiplication of initTotalTokens by 10**decimals.
initTotalTokens flows into the constructor supply computation.
decimals is used as the exponent of the unchecked constructor multiplication.
Constructor credits the full supply to balances[owner].
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
totalSupply calls SafeMath.sub for a checked subtraction.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance.
transfer uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
transfer mutates the balances state variable.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on both balance and allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance mapping.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by the onlyOwner check implemented alongside transferOwnership.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an owner-supplied token contract.
The arbitrary token contract called by transferAnyERC20Token can re-enter the token contract during the sweep.
Swept tokens are sent to the owner address from the external call.
_newOwner is assigned to the newOwner state variable.
Recipient parameter to is used in transfer balance updates.
Amount parameter tokens drives the transfer arithmetic.
spender parameter keys the allowance written by approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value set by approve.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances lookup in balanceOf.
res local variable carries the totalSupply return value.
Untrusted tokenAddress parameter becomes the external call target of the owner-only sweep.
tokens parameter is the sweep amount passed to the external transfer.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: initTotalTokens is only used inside the unchecked constructor multiplication, so fold the parameter into that unsafe operation.
_newOwner only feeds the newOwner assignment inside transferOwnership; merge into that access-control function.
